classes.name: HttpRequestsPropertiesMatcher

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the matcher to a request definition, updating internal state if necessary.

methods.description: Creates an HttpRequest object based on OpenAPI operation and parameters.

methods.name: buildSecurityValues
methods.description: Builds security-related header, query, and cookie requirements from OpenAPI security schemes.

methods.name: handleRequestBody
methods.description: Handles request body content types and schemas, adding matchers accordingly.

methods.name: addRequestMatcher
methods.description: Adds an HttpRequest and corresponding matcher to internal lists.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a request matches the stored request properties.
